title: A check flags a waiting-page item that holds an owner answer but stays open
why: On 13:28 CST Nov 11 the page showed 23 open items; 19 held owner answers from Nov 6-10 that triage never closed, so the owner could not tell what still needed him.
note: Triage mistake, found when the owner asked 13:28 CST whether the page was stale. Source: answers collection fetch1312. The check reads items and answers at the page copy and lists each open item with an answer, for the page writer to close with the owner's words and a home. Meanwhile triage sweeps the 19 by hand.
